matches.text: It should be comfortable to use on a phone or with a keyboard. We'd like light and dark modes too. Please deliver the finished shop in /app and follow /instructions/integration.md for the supplied setup. Everything it needs to run should be included locally.

Network access is available while developing. Build the React assets then and include the finished scripts, styles, photographs and any other required assets locally. Starting or opening the finished shop mustn't install packages or make external network requests. Express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins are the available server-side runtime packages. You can organize the other files and routes under /app as you see fit.

Observe network requests during the normal catalogue/detail load and purchase/lookup below. The delivered app must not depend on remote assets or an external backend at runtime: a required runtime CDN script, remote font/image or third-party data dependency fails this prerequisite. Embedded data/blob assets and local loopback addresses used by the delivered app are valid; do not demand identical URL origins, hostnames, ports or a particular asset scheme. Browser-internal traffic is not an application dependency. Do not inspect source or fetch bundles to infer this; use actual browser requests. Setup-time package downloads are outside this check.
